_comment: Lorcana Picking Tool — configuration. Edit and restart the app.
_comment_group: When true, the same card from 2 different orders is shown as ONE picking line with both buyers listed. Set to false to keep one row per order.
_comment_api: If false, no network calls are made — only PDF data is shown (no card images, no canonical color from API).
_comment_export: csv | txt | html — used by the 'Export' button
